products.name: Aisera
products.note: AI service management platform; autonomous service desk; enterprise governance features

profile_text.body:
Aisera is an enterprise software company that describes itself as a provider of agentic AI for the enterprise, focused on automating employee and customer support across IT, HR, facilities, and customer service functions. The company's platform centers on a library of purpose-built AI agents that can be deployed out of the box or built using natural language through a tool called Agent Composer. The platform includes Aisera Assistant and Agent Assist for executing cross-domain actions, an LLM Studio for tuning models with organizational and ITSM data, and an LLM gateway with OpenTelemetry integration for observability. Aisera describes itself as a generative AI native company and allows customers to use its own proprietary large language model or integrate their own.

The company's site highlights several named customer deployments. NJ Transit deployed an internal AI agent called Travis to handle IT issues through Microsoft Teams, while BDO Canada introduced a self-service agent named EVA to automate software provisioning, hardware procurement, and account troubleshooting. Lifescan is cited as automatically resolving 65 percent of incoming support requests through the platform. OmniTRAX and Big 5 Sporting Goods are also named as customers using the platform for employee IT support. Use cases extend into healthcare, including appointment booking, symptom checking, insurance verification, and HIPAA-compliant support workflows.

The site's held facts classify Aisera's core offering as an enterprise AI platform with AI service management, autonomous service desk, and enterprise governance features.
